action.objective: Commit the verified Kb1, keeping the king off the h-file and preserving material while the rook stays active on g5.
action.rationale: a2b1 is the only commit-ready move: exact score 0 at completed depth 3 with quiescence, complete immediate-mate safety, and both tactical and checking-chain probes not_found. Black's only listed capture Rxc2 is not clearly winning and no forced mate was found. This keeps the king safe from h-file checks and avoids the risky g5 rook retreats that scored worse (-558).
